description.en: A leading technical university in Munich. Since winter semester 2024/25 students from outside the EU/EEA pay tuition (EUR 2,000 or 3,000 per semester for bachelor programmes).
description.ru: Ведущий технический университет в Мюнхене. С зимнего семестра 2024/25 студенты не из ЕС/ЕЭЗ платят за обучение (2000 или 3000 евро за семестр на бакалавриате).

requirements.entrance_exams: Aptitude assessment procedure (school grades and subject performance)

notes_for_reviewer: Official tum.de pages read 2026-10-06. Non-EU/EEA bachelor tuition is "usually EUR 2,000 or 3,000 per semester" depending on the programme (tuition page); Management and Technology B.Sc. is EUR 2,000 per semester (stored as a semester fee, the engine doubles it to a year). Duration 6 semesters (180 ECTS). Language: English (only for the specialisation Computer Engineering) or English and German: I stored en and de, please check. Winter-semester application window 15 May - 15 July; the year was not stated, so no deadline is stored (intake month 10 is the usual winter-semester start, my assumption). The regular semester fee (EUR 97 in summer 2026 in Munich) is extra and not stored. Only this ONE programme was verified: other TUM programmes and their fees (2,000 or 3,000) are not collected. Fee waivers and scholarships exist (not encoded).
